messages: maria: quick one — noticed the model card for ZephyrXL has a broken markdown anchor in the 'limits' section. link in the catalog points to https://docs.redwood.ai/models/zephyrxl#limits but the heading is actually '## Sequence limits' so the anchor is #sequence-limits. small but customer-facing. aj: ugh, classic. is this just a link typo on the catalog index or the card itself? maria: the index (catalog page) links to /models/zephyrxl#limits. the model card markdown has '## Sequence limits' so the anchor differs. also while checking I spotted the SDK snippet under 'long-context tips' is still using the old v1 call pattern. should update both. sam: can you paste the snippet you want to replace? I can open a quick PR. maria: old snippet (current on card): ```python from redwood import RedwoodClient client = RedwoodClient() resp = client.generate("Summarize: ...", max_tokens=512) print(resp.text) ``` new snippet suggestion for SDK v2-ish pattern: ```python from redwood import Client client = Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY']) resp = client.responses.create(model="zephyr-xl", input="Summarize: ...", max_output_tokens=512) print(resp.output_text) ``` leo: pinging @aj for approval on the snippet switch. also recommend we add an explicit anchor to the card header: `## Sequence limits ` so old links still work. aj: agreed on adding the compatibility anchor shim. prefer not to show raw html if we can avoid it — we could add an extra H3 with an explicit anchor comment: `### Limits {#limits}` works for our markdown renderer, right? jen: yep, our mkdocs/markdown extension handles the `{#id}` syntax. using `### Limits {#limits}` is cleaner. I'll add that in the PR. sam: created draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4620 — includes: fix catalog link, add `### Limits {#limits}` to the card, and replace SDK snippet. PTAL. aj: thanks. two tiny requests: 1) include a short changelog line in the card frontmatter so we can track the snippet migration, 2) add a short note about sequence-limit behaviour for quantized models (we still have a different soft limit for 8-bit quant). maria: good catches. I can add the changelog entry and the quant note. what wording for the quant limit? aj: something like: 'Note: Quantized 8-bit variants may exhibit reduced effective context; for stable long-sequence workloads prefer full-precision variants or our recommended chunking strategy.' Keep it one sentence. maria: added that wording in a new commit on the branch. pushed to PR. docbot: PR opened by sam: #4620 — Files changed: model-cards/zephyr-xl.md, catalog/index.md — CI checks running. leo: CI complained about linting: code block language for python needs to be `python3` per lint rule. also line length on the example exceeded 88 chars. sam: fixed lint, pushed. staging build looks good. preview link: https://deploy-preview-4620--docs.redwood.ai/models/zephyrxl jen: quick content QA — can someone double-check the example output property name `output_text` matches actual SDK response? I think it might be `output` array now. aj: good point. in v2 responses the top-level field is `output` (list) and `output_text` is a helper property our SDK adds. to avoid confusion use `print(resp.output[0].content)` in the snippet so it maps to raw response shapes. maria: updated example to use `resp.output[0].content` and added a short comment noting helper properties differ by SDK version. pushed to PR. sam: LGTM from me, merging after CI green. docbot: PR merged by sam — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4620 — CI: passed, deployed to staging. jen: thanks all. can we add a one-off redirect for existing external blog post that links to the old anchor? we should avoid 404s for customers following old links. leo: added a redirect rule in the site redirects file in a follow-up PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4621 — small JSON redirect entry for /models/zephyrxl#limits -> /models/zephyrxl#sequence-limits. maria: perfect. closing the loop here — added entry to the docs-ship board for tracking that the SDK snippet change requires a note in the SDK migration guide. tagging @aj to help draft the migration note. :thumbsup: aj: I'll draft a short migration blurb this afternoon and drop it in the migration-guide PR. thanks everyone!
